how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ashenvale-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6503:obj:0: Kill 9 ⟦E1⟧, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.
rows.quest:6503:details:0: We received reports that ⟦E2⟧ outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!
rows.quest:6503:details:1: Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the ⟦E3⟧ outpost of Silverwing. Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
rows.quest:6503:progress:0: I await reports of your outrunner kills, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:6503:completion:0: Very good, ⟦2⟧. Your hunting skills are impressive...
rows.quest:6503:completion:1: The loss of those outrunners help blind the ⟦E3⟧, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
rows.quest:6544:obj:0: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel ⟦E4⟧, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6544:details:1: My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our ⟦E5⟧ is its leader, Duriel ⟦E4⟧. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. The ⟦E6⟧ will be glorious!
rows.quest:6544:details:2: Do you want to share in the glory, ⟦4⟧, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.
rows.quest:6544:details:3: What do you say. Are you with us?
rows.quest:6544:progress:0: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?
rows.quest:6544:completion:0: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, ⟦5⟧. ⟦E7⟧ are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the ⟦E6⟧ was something to see...
rows.quest:6544:completion:1: And I hope you gained a scar or two!
rows.quest:25:obj:0: Dispatch 12 Befouled ⟦E8⟧ at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:25:obj:1: Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the ⟦E9⟧ ⟦E3⟧ outpost.
rows.quest:25:obj:2: Return to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:25:details:0: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?
rows.quest:25:details:1: The transports between ⟦E2⟧ and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the ⟦E3⟧ outpost there.
rows.quest:25:progress:0: You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?
rows.quest:25:completion:0: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the ⟦E10⟧. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our ⟦E3⟧ friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...
rows.quest:25:completion:1: Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.
rows.quest:1009:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E11⟧ to Talen near the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1009:details:0: I ⟦E12⟧ the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.
rows.quest:1009:details:1: That key is a ring, the ⟦E11⟧. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.
rows.quest:1009:details:2: For years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.
rows.quest:1009:details:3: Their leader, ⟦E13⟧, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram. Please, ⟦6⟧, retrieve the ring for me!
rows.quest:1009:progress:0: It is said that the ⟦E11⟧ is the key to any lock within the city. Do you have it, ⟦7⟧?
rows.quest:1009:completion:0: You found the ring! Thank you, ⟦8⟧. Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
rows.quest:1017:obj:0: Slay Sarilus Foulborne and bring his head to Sentinel Velene Starstrike in Silverwind Refuge.
rows.quest:1017:details:0: There's only one ⟦E14⟧ mage in the ⟦E10⟧ capable of defiling this many water elementals. He's also the only one foolish enough to try. Sarilus Foulborne is probably sitting at the top of ⟦E15⟧, laughing at me.
rows.quest:1017:details:1: B⟦9⟧, you must go into ⟦E16⟧ territory and destroy this miscreant. I have had enough of his idiocy and we must show him what happens to those who annoy the Sentinels.
rows.quest:1017:details:2: Destroy him and bring me his head. Be wary though, the ⟦E17⟧ may be watching for you.
rows.quest:1017:progress:0: Is it done? Is Sarilus Foulborne dead?
rows.quest:1017:completion:0: Now I can see that repugnant smile wiped from his face forever. You have done very well, ⟦10⟧. Take this, the ⟦E18⟧, drink of it when all seems lost and death is near. It may save you, Goddess willing.
rows.quest:1054:obj:0: Bring ⟦E19⟧ to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1054:details:0: Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.
rows.quest:1054:details:1: Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.
rows.quest:1054:details:2: I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. ⟦E20⟧ be with you.
rows.quest:1054:progress:0: The furbolgs' corruption has caused ⟦E2⟧ to become a fraction of its former glory.
rows.quest:1054:completion:1: We are under constant ⟦E21⟧ from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
rows.quest:6441:obj:0: Collect 16 ⟦E22⟧ for Pixel in Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6441:details:0: Heya! I've been traveling through ⟦E2⟧, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.
rows.quest:6441:details:1: After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!
rows.quest:6441:details:2: Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
rows.quest:6441:progress:0: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, ⟦12⟧. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
rows.quest:6441:completion:0: These are perfect, ⟦13⟧! Thanks for helping me out!
rows.quest:6441:completion:1: Oh, and this is for your time...
rows.quest:6621:obj:0: Place ⟦E23⟧ on the Foulweald ⟦E24⟧ Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring ⟦E25⟧ to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.
rows.quest:6621:details:0: ⟦14⟧, another tribe of Furbolgs, the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar. They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future ⟦E21⟧. With a show of force, we can remove that ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:6621:details:1: Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their ⟦E26⟧ mound. They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe. Bring me the ⟦E26⟧ he carries.
rows.quest:6621:details:2: Gather your ⟦E27⟧, ⟦15⟧. This is no task for a single ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:6621:progress:0: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, ⟦17⟧? Did you retrieve his Foulweald ⟦E24⟧?
rows.quest:6621:completion:0: Good work, ⟦18⟧. Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:
rows.quest:6621:completion:1: The ⟦E17⟧ is not to be trifled with.
rows.quest:6621:completion:2: I don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.
rows.quest:24:obj:0: Bring ⟦E28⟧ to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:24:details:0: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it. The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt. Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt.
rows.quest:24:progress:0: Greetings once again, ⟦19⟧! Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
rows.quest:24:completion:0: A victory for ⟦20⟧ in the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt! Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.
rows.quest:24:completion:1: Shadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
rows.quest:824:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E29⟧ to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:824:details:0: The ⟦E30⟧ is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.
rows.quest:824:details:1: Lucky for you, I know someone in the ⟦E30⟧ here in ⟦E2⟧. ⟦E31⟧ over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.
rows.quest:824:progress:0: Ah, hello there. I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.⟦21⟧⟦22⟧Is there something I can help you with?
rows.quest:824:completion:0: This globe... it is most disturbing. Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices. To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.
rows.quest:824:completion:1: I will see that this globe is studied properly by the ⟦E30⟧. Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements. Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:1026:obj:0: Find the ⟦E32⟧ and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1026:details:0: I wish your tidings were better.
rows.quest:1026:details:1: Raene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.
rows.quest:1026:details:2: If your goal is to find the next piece of the rod, then you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.
rows.quest:1026:details:3: The wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here, near ⟦E33⟧. Once you have it, look for a small glade west of the road near the ⟦E33⟧ border... the chest should be hidden around there.
rows.quest:1026:progress:0: It upsets me so that the treants have become corrupt. I wish I could do more to help them.
rows.quest:1026:completion:0: I'm pleased to see you're back, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:1918:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E29⟧ to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1918:details:0: The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water. The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting. It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.
rows.quest:1918:details:1: It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.
rows.quest:1918:completion:0: You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me? Who am I, the ⟦E30⟧ or something?
rows.quest:1918:completion:1: Actually, that does give me an idea... perhaps you do need the ⟦E30⟧ for this. I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.
rows.quest:6571:obj:0: Collect the ⟦E34⟧: ⟦E35⟧, ⟦E36⟧, ⟦E37⟧, and the ⟦E38⟧ for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6571:details:0: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
rows.quest:6571:details:1: Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.
rows.quest:6571:details:2: Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!
rows.quest:6571:progress:0: I hope you can come through with the supplies!
rows.quest:6571:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦25⟧. You've saved me a lot of work!
rows.quest:6571:completion:1: But don't think that I'm not grateful!
rows.quest:1027:obj:0: Find the final piece of Dartol's Rod and return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1027:details:0: The final piece of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil for safekeeping. I have no idea where they hid it. I'm sorry I can't help you more than that.
rows.quest:1027:details:1: All I can tell you is to follow the road that leads towards the ⟦E10⟧. The druids took shelter to the east of that road, but they won't be of much help to you: they were killed recently... it's something I don't like to think about much.
rows.quest:1027:details:2: When you find the final piece, bring it to me and I will help you reconstruct the rod.
rows.quest:1027:progress:0: Did you find the final piece of the rod, ⟦26⟧?
rows.quest:1027:completion:0: You found the final piece? Wonderful for you... and for Raene.
rows.quest:1027:completion:1: I guess we'll have to see about repairing it, won't we?
rows.quest:1028:obj:0: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.
rows.quest:1028:details:0: Here is the completed rod, ⟦27⟧. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.
rows.quest:1028:details:1: With some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.
rows.quest:1028:details:2: ⟦E31⟧ southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.
rows.quest:1028:details:3: Once there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. Hehe.
rows.quest:1028:progress:0: You can sense a subtle yet powerful force within the shrine and surrounding trees.⟦28⟧⟦29⟧You begin placing the rod within the shrine and a soft thrumming noise emits from around you as the shrine begins to glow...
rows.quest:1028:completion:0: After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.
rows.quest:1029:obj:0: Return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1029:details:0: I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.
rows.quest:1029:completion:0: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear.
rows.quest:1029:completion:1: Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
rows.quest:1030:obj:0: Find an uncorrupted furbolg, and using the power of ⟦E39⟧, speak to him.
rows.quest:1030:details:0: Alas, I'm not completely certain what he had in mind next.
rows.quest:1030:details:1: If what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another ⟦E40⟧ altogether. Which ⟦E40⟧, I do not know.
rows.quest:1030:details:2: Perhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to the tainted furbolgs, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was safe from the effects of ⟦E41⟧.
rows.quest:1030:details:3: I would start your search southeast of Mystral Lake.
rows.quest:1030:completion:0: Yes, yes... you are one of my kind, but still whole. Still clean.
rows.quest:1030:completion:1: I am unsure how you have escaped the atrocities the night elves have visited upon our people, but I am glad to know that I am no longer alone.
rows.quest:1030:completion:2: ⟦E42⟧ now runs through the veins of our kin, young one, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe.
rows.quest:1030:completion:3: At night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.
rows.quest:1055:obj:0: Return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1055:details:0: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.
rows.quest:1011:obj:0: Bring a ⟦E43⟧ to ⟦E44⟧ in Forest Song.
rows.quest:1011:details:0: The ⟦E45⟧, the ⟦E14⟧ arm of the ⟦E17⟧, have crept into ⟦E2⟧, lurking at our ruins and our barrows. We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves. We must confirm this!
rows.quest:1011:details:1: The ⟦E45⟧ have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles. Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease. Return with such a bottle. I will test it and find its purpose.
rows.quest:1011:progress:0: Did you find the camp, ⟦32⟧? Do you have a bottle of disease?
rows.quest:1011:completion:0: Very good, ⟦33⟧. Now... by testing the contents of this bottle, the goals of the ⟦E45⟧ will be revealed!
rows.quest:4581:details:0: The druid ⟦E44⟧ sent word to me. He would like a report of the happenings along our coast and in the forests surrounding Astranaar. He fears there is a corruption moving through ⟦E2⟧... and he may be right.
rows.quest:4581:details:1: Here, take my report to him. You will find him in the shrine of Forest Song, in the Nightsong Woods to the east.
rows.quest:4581:progress:0: Do you have something for me?
rows.quest:4581:completion:0: Ah, Shindrell's report! Many thanks, ⟦34⟧. Shindrell is a fine sentinel, brave and keen. I must read this for clues of a wickedness I ⟦E12⟧ is moving through ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:98027:title: ⟦E47⟧
rows.quest:98027:obj:0: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.
rows.quest:2:obj:0: Bring ⟦E48⟧ to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2:details:0: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
rows.quest:2:progress:0: Yes, mighty ⟦35⟧, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
rows.quest:2:completion:0: Most impressive, ⟦36⟧... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! ⟦E49⟧ goes well for you!
rows.quest:2:completion:1: Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:247:completion:0: ⟦37⟧, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!
rows.quest:247:completion:1: Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in ⟦E2⟧ for the ⟦E17⟧ today. May your ancestors watch over you!
rows.quest:1022:obj:0: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.
rows.quest:1022:details:0: Though we have put many resources and much effort into driving the remaining demons from the ⟦E33⟧ to the north, our successes have been few. We have been able to keep much of the demonic presence from ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1022:details:1: To the north, near the ⟦E33⟧ border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their chilling calls have led the area to be known as the Howling Vale. The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept at the shrine may shed some light on why these wolf-men have come.
rows.quest:1022:progress:0: The tome of the shrine is a mysterious object. It is not a book in the traditional sense. The leaves of the tome were blessed by Mel'Thandris herself, and records events of import in its pages.⟦38⟧⟦39⟧It is hard for me to explain. If you go to the shrine, you will understand.
rows.quest:1022:completion:0: The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in strange ways. The events it records, the events it shows... No one truly understands why it does what it does.
rows.quest:1022:completion:1: Nonetheless, it is clear that what Priestess Starsong received--this Scythe of ⟦E20⟧--bears further investigation.
rows.quest:1035:obj:0: Retrieve a ⟦E50⟧ from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1035:details:0: Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak. I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost. I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.
rows.quest:1035:details:1: We used to gather moonstones at ⟦E51⟧ to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.
rows.quest:1035:details:2: Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them. Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.
rows.quest:1035:details:3: And to do that, I ⟦E12⟧ that you must slay him.
rows.quest:1035:progress:0: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, ⟦40⟧? If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
rows.quest:1035:completion:0: Oh, ⟦41⟧, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!
rows.quest:1035:completion:1: I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. ⟦E52⟧ than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
rows.quest:1037:obj:0: Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the ⟦E53⟧'s Terrace in ⟦E54⟧.
rows.quest:1037:details:0: ⟦E55⟧ was my predecessor here in ⟦E2⟧ Forest. At first it seemed she had the situation in ⟦E33⟧ under control, but little by little her efforts faltered. One day, she simply disappeared.
rows.quest:1037:details:1: I was sent here to continue her work. I'm afraid I know nothing of the priestess, however. Perhaps Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows further details of her disappearance that I was not a ⟦E56⟧ to.
rows.quest:1037:details:2: Surely she will understand the import of such information.
rows.quest:1037:completion:0: ⟦E55⟧? That the priestess disappeared some time ago is almost certainly common knowledge. As to further details about the events that surrounded her departure... it would take good reason for me to divulge such information.
rows.quest:1038:obj:0: Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in ⟦E54⟧.
rows.quest:1038:details:0: The Tome of Mel'Thandris showed you this? I suppose there would be little harm in allowing you to examine her belongings. This key will allow you to open the chest where we stored her things in the Sentinels' bunkhouse. She kept a journal of her duties, if there is anything to be learned, it will be from that.
rows.quest:1038:details:1: I should tell you, the Sentinels believe that she had her own reasons for leaving, and expect that she could return at any time. The priestess has done much in the past to earn our trust.
rows.quest:1038:completion:0: It seems that Velinde's disappearance is more troubling than it originally appeared. Even still, I cannot believe that she has come to a bad end. Perhaps it would be beneficial for us to make contact with her.
rows.quest:1038:completion:1: B⟦42⟧, since you have shown a vested interest in this matter, I would like to enlist your aid.
rows.quest:1039:details:0: Ratchet is the only port in the ⟦E10⟧. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in ⟦E58⟧. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers.
rows.quest:1039:details:1: Follow the road southeast through ⟦E2⟧ and you will find yourself in the ⟦E10⟧. Watch your step, ⟦43⟧, warriors of the ⟦E17⟧ patrol the land. You will be safe at the port, though.
rows.quest:1039:completion:0: ⟦44⟧, eh? Must admit, we don't get much of your type out here. Looking for someone, eh? Just give me a moment, I'm sure I have it written in one of my ledgers.
rows.quest:1039:completion:1: Lot of people travel through here, though, so just give me a moment.
rows.quest:1040:obj:0: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
rows.quest:1040:details:0: Ah yes, finally found it. Should have told me she passed through here that long ago. Let's see.
rows.quest:1040:details:1: Velinde. Booked passage to Booty Bay on the Black Osprey. I don't have anything here saying otherwise, so I'd assume it arrived in port safely.
rows.quest:1040:details:2: Not much more help I can be to you, but she asked about overland travel over on that side of the world, and I mentioned Ruzzgot, a caravan driver based out of Booty Bay. Might be that this Velinde traveled with him.
rows.quest:1040:details:3: Move along, now. I haven't all day for you.
rows.quest:1040:completion:0: Yes? Now, it doesn't look to me like you're the sort with goods that need shipping, so either you're looking for a job with my caravan--and there's no jobs to be had now--or you're probably talking to the wrong goblin.
rows.quest:1041:obj:0: Speak with Clerk Daltry in Darkshire.
rows.quest:1041:details:0: Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday.
rows.quest:1041:details:1: It just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old--but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own.
rows.quest:1041:details:2: We split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. Might know something useful.
rows.quest:1041:details:3: Be careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.
rows.quest:1041:completion:0: With all the strange happenings of the last few years, I keep as good records of strangers as I can. Never know when it might come in handy... though it's usually not pleasant business when it does. Not to suggest anything about this Velinde you're looking for.
